name: Internal Workspace View (Staff Tool)
summary: Staff-facing tool layout using GoabWorkSideMenu with a persistent side navigation and a paginated data table. Use this shell for any internal, worker, or case-management application. NEVER use GoabOneColumnLayout, GoabAppHeader, GoabAppFooter, or GoabHeroBanner for internal tools.
whenToUse: Target audience is government staff, not citizens
User describes a 'workspace', 'case management', 'admin', 'review queue', 'staff tool', or 'internal dashboard'
The app needs persistent side navigation rather than a top header
Multiple list/detail views need to coexist under a shared nav

structure.nav: GoabWorkSideMenuItem entries in primaryContent — one per route
structure.content: GoabPageBlock width='1200px' inside a scrollable main element
structure.list: GoabTable version='2' with GoabTableSortHeader and GoabPagination for tabular data
structure.loading: goa-skeleton type='text' size='4' inside aria-label='Loading' wrapper
structure.error: GoabCallout type='emergency' with a Retry button
structure.badge: GoabBadge for status colours on coded fields

requiredElements: GoabWorkSideMenu with heading and userName props
GoabWorkSideMenuItem for each primary route — current prop drives active highlight
onClick on each item calls e.preventDefault() then navigate()
main element with id='main-content' and overflow-y auto for scroll containment
GoabPageBlock width='1200px' for data-heavy views (640px for forms, 1000px for general)
version='2' on GoabTable and GoabPagination — omitting it renders V1 styling inside a V2 app

imports: import { GoabWorkSideMenu, GoabWorkSideMenuItem, GoabPageBlock, GoabTable, GoabBadge, GoabCallout, GoabButton, GoabPagination } from '@abgov/react-components';

notes: GoabWorkSideMenu REPLACES GoabOneColumnLayout + GoabAppHeader + GoabAppFooter — never use both in the same app
GoabHeroBanner is citizen-facing only — never appears in a staff tool
version='2' is required on GoabTable, GoabTableSortHeader, and GoabPagination — omitting it renders V1 styling in a V2 design system app
The loadSeq ref pattern prevents stale responses from overwriting newer data when page/sort changes fire overlapping requests
GoabPageBlock width: 640px for forms, 1000px for general content, 1200px for data tables
Skip-to-main-content link and id='main-content' on main are required for keyboard accessibility
